Proposition
[Proper surface interpolation] 1. 9.4.3\group thurston.ch09.tamenessSource: thurston:page-0258Source: thurston:page-0259 If a proper map $F:S_{[\epsilon ,\infty )}\times [0,\infty )\to E$ has uniformly controlled negatively curved slices and exits every compact set in the end direction, then it can be homotoped to a proper product structure, yielding topological tameness.
